[b]No, You cannot call yourself アマラロ天皇 (Amararo Tennō) [/b]

"Sir, you cannot call yourself the Emperor of Amaralo," began the steward of the royal house, Bjørn Niels.

"Why not? Am I not the Emperor of Elesyr? And no one has objected?" enquired Erjk Drs.

"W-well yes your majesty, but, that is more respectable, than declaring yourself emperor over, well, Amaralo...indeed, Pantagruel, should already have that title," replied Bjørn.

"Bah! I feel like I can't do anything! Emperor, and with what powers?" huffed Erjk.

"The powers given to you by the constitution, your majesty," replied Bjørn.

"So I can't send colonists to Amaralo and set up shop there then?" enquired Erjk.

"Well you could, but it would be hard to get the Fondenfoddel to agree to such a measure, it is rather, drastic, and risks painting you as a radical expansionist, your claim in Ismyr is already heavily disliked for being so far from main Imperial borders," replied Bjørn.

"Very well then, I shall shelve the idea for now, but, should it become prudent to do so in time, I shall push my hand through the Fondenfoddel," replied Erjk.
